description: Conflict resolution vectors of STANDARD v1.2.0 section 8.2. Each vector gives the candidates for one field of one entity, with their evidence, and a strategy (null: highest_score). The expected result is chosen (winner), merged (order: every candidate, highest score first) or escalated (tied: the candidates left tied; every one for escalate_to_human), or an error: a conflict in which a candidate has no static weight is refused. Two values are equal when they differ by at most 1e-12; candidates the strategy leaves tied go through the model's tie_breakers in order (a vector's tie_breakers replace them). `model` holds the trust model the vectors read: the weights and decay of schemas/authority_trust_model.yaml, its field_authority.fields and its tie_breakers. Normative (section 10.3). grounded_agency/trust.py is the reference implementation (resolve); tests/test_trust.py runs it against this file.

fields.name: The vector's name, unique in this file.
fields.field: The field in conflict, for the model's field authorities. Absent: none.
fields.strategy: A strategy of section 8.2, or null for the default, highest_score.
fields.profile_trust_weights: The trust_weights of the applied profiles, merged. Absent: none.
fields.tie_breakers: Replaces the model's tie_breakers. Absent: the model's.
fields.candidates: Each candidate's evidence: source_type and trust_class (either or both), age_hours, and confidence (absent: none reported).
fields.expect: {outcome, winner?, order?, tied?, scores?} or {error: true}. scores, when given: every candidate's trust score, each within `tolerance`.

vectors.name: single_candidate
vectors.about: A conflict with one candidate chooses it.

vectors.name: single_candidate_escalate
vectors.about: One candidate is chosen whatever the strategy: escalate_to_human does not escalate it.

vectors.name: single_candidate_merge
vectors.about: One candidate is chosen whatever the strategy: merge_with_uncertainty does not merge it.

vectors.name: default_highest_score
vectors.about: No strategy named: highest_score. A fresh human note (0.55 * 0.5 ** (1/240)) beats a system-of-record value two half-lives old (0.92 * 0.25).

vectors.name: default_named
vectors.about: highest_score named: the same result.

vectors.name: default_tie_authority
vectors.about: Equal scores (0.92 each, a class weight and a source weight); for serial_number the tie-breaker prefer_authoritative_source keeps the system_of_record source.

vectors.name: default_tie_confidence
vectors.about: Equal scores (0.55 * 1 * 0.5 and 0.55 * 0.5 * 1), no field: no authority, so prefer_high_confidence decides.

vectors.name: default_tie_escalates
vectors.about: Identical candidates: every tie-breaker leaves both, so the conflict is escalated.

vectors.name: tie_within_tolerance
vectors.about: Scores that differ by less than 1e-12 are equal; so are the confidences, so the tie stands.

vectors.name: authoritative_restricts
vectors.about: prefer_authoritative_sources for deployment_version: only the authority (primary_api, 0.88) competes, though hardware_sensor weighs 0.95.

vectors.name: authoritative_by_weight_not_score
vectors.about: Two authorities for serial_number: the higher static weight wins (hardware_sensor, 0.95), though its score is lower for its age.

vectors.name: authoritative_none_present
vectors.about: No candidate is an authority for serial_number: all compete, by static weight.

vectors.name: prefer_recent
vectors.about: The lowest age wins, whatever the weight.

vectors.name: prefer_recent_tie_breakers
vectors.about: Equal ages: the model's tie-breakers apply; with no field, prefer_high_confidence decides.

vectors.name: prefer_high_confidence
vectors.about: The highest confidence wins.

vectors.name: merge_orders_by_score
vectors.about: merge_with_uncertainty keeps every candidate, highest score first, equal scores in the order given.

vectors.name: escalate
vectors.about: escalate_to_human chooses no candidate.

vectors.name: tie_breakers_prefer_recent
vectors.about: tie_breakers given ([prefer_recent]) replace the model's: the equal-score tie of default_tie_confidence goes to the fresher candidate.

vectors.name: profile_changes_winner
vectors.about: A profile lowers hardware_sensor to 0.5: primary_api (0.88) wins.

vectors.name: unweighable_candidate
vectors.about: A candidate without a static weight makes the conflict refused, whatever the strategy: it is not resolved by leaving the candidate out.
